_comment: One case table for two implementations of the same rule: inboxHealthStatus() in supabase/functions/mcp-server/inbox-health.ts (null means ok) and inboxHealth() in apps/web/src/lib/inboxes/health.ts. inbox-health.test.ts (Deno) and apps/web/src/lib/inboxes/health.test.ts (node) both read this file, so the two cannot drift. noMailboxMessage must equal OUTLOOK_NO_MAILBOX_MESSAGE (outlook-graph.ts) and OUTLOOK_NO_MAILBOX_REASON (apps/web outlook-oauth.ts); both tests check it.
noMailboxMessage: This Microsoft account has no Outlook / Exchange Online mailbox that Microsoft Graph can reach. Microsoft accepted the sign-in, but there is no mailbox behind it: typically an administrator account without an Exchange Online licence, or an organisation whose mail is hosted somewhere else. Reconnecting will not change this. If the address's mail is hosted on another server, remove this inbox and connect the address with IMAP instead.
